points.point: During fiscal 2026, the company recorded an impairment charge of $15.6 million related to a leased property asset group in San Jose, California.
points.quote: As a result of a sublease transaction involving a leased property in San Jose, California during the first quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company estimated the fair value of the sublease assets using discounted cash flows from the estimated net sublease rental income discounted at a market rate and recorded an impairment charge of $ 15.6 million in special charges, net which represented the excess carrying value of the asset group associated with the leased property over its estimated fair value.

points.point: Federal and state net operating losses totaling $310.2 million are scheduled to begin expiring in fiscal 2027.
points.quote: The federal and state net operating losses of $ 310.2 million will begin to expire in fiscal 2027 while foreign net operating loss carryovers of $ 131.8 million have no expiration date.

points.point: The company entered into a 364-day unsecured revolving credit facility providing up to $3.0 billion in additional borrowing capacity.
points.quote: The 364 -Day Revolving Credit Agreement provides for a 364 -day unsecured revolving credit facility in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $ 3.0 billion, expiring on July 1, 2027.
